svg.title: 山河为证，信仰不息
svg.desc: AI辅助题字母版经Alpha轮廓算法重建的真实路径。非字库转曲，非人工手写；保留自然字形与少量飞白。
svg.metadata:
{"text": "山河为证，信仰不息", "source": "declaration-master.png", "sourceSha256": "4c984ad50918bbd3695ff26516b9c60c9f8fbfe0a48d196e93ac3f6789509cf0", "sourceType": "AI-assisted lettering generated with built-in image_gen; not human handwriting, a font, or font outlines", "generationTool": "image_gen.imagegen", "generationModel": "not exposed by built-in tool", "transparent_background": true, "referenced_image_paths": null, "promptFile": "declaration-prompt.txt", "prompt": "Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: Chinese calligraphic title master, intended for alpha tracing into vector paths for a memorial website.
Primary request: Create one independent transparent-background Chinese brush-lettering artwork, in a single horizontal line, accurately reading “山河为证，信仰不息”. Exactly eight Chinese characters and one Chinese comma; no other text.
Text (verbatim): "山河为证，信仰不息"
Character sequence: 山 / 河 / 为 / 证 / ， / 信 / 仰 / 不 / 息. Use simplified Chinese. The third character MUST be 为. The seventh Chinese character MUST be 不. Do not substitute characters.
Style/medium: strong but restrained Chinese running script 行书, with the upright bone structure and angular cuts of monumental stone inscriptions 碑刻. Thick brush bellies, decisive cut-tip stroke endings, a small amount of deliberate dry-brush negative space. Formal, legible, composed. A coherent natural calligraphic family, not a typeset computer font, not overly cursive.
Composition/framing: one single left-to-right horizontal line only, eight evenly balanced characters with a modest comma, enough natural inter-character spacing for clear reading at only 400 CSS pixels wide. Natural high-bodied characters, with subtly varied character widths and a steady baseline. Do not squash strokes vertically. No giant sweeping flourish or underline. Make the artwork as large as fits on a wide canvas; preserve a clear transparent margin around all ink.
Color palette: all brush marks warm paper white #f3e7d2, one flat ink color. True transparent background.
Constraints: text accuracy is the highest priority; only the lettering and comma; preserve internal counters and sparse white-space dry-brush texture as transparency. No shadows, no glow, no bloom, no gradient, no outline, no paper, no seal, no border, no watermark, no added symbols. This is secondary lettering under a larger hero title.
", "method": "Threshold generated alpha, median filter, remove isolated regions under 16px, reconstruct spline contours with vtracer 0.6.15; no manual stroke redrawing", "parameters": {"alphaThreshold": 128, "medianFilterSize": 3, "minimumConnectedArea": 16, "padding": 48, "colormode": "binary", "mode": "spline", "filter_speckle": 4, "corner_threshold": 60, "length_threshold": 6.0, "splice_threshold": 45, "path_precision": 3}, "characterGeometry": "unaltered; no anisotropic scaling", "characterTranslationsX": null, "processedAlphaSha256": "a156e28c11a5a16e0227b49948f621830097dddcd155bb47cffc27842c8e3669", "inkDimensions": [2088, 408], "inkAspectRatio": 5.117647}
